reason: B speaks to my belief that members have plenty of chains: the nearest chain is more than 20 miles away, and two pharmacies have said they will stop filling for plan members. It also admits that brand-name drugs offset part of the loss, makes one specific ask, offers invoices and a meeting before May 1, and comes from a named owner. A has unfilled placeholders, adds a PBM disclosure demand the brief never mentions, and leans on vaguer warnings that read like the usual annual complaint.
